content.short: Nimbus is a personalized on-chain portfolio for Web3 investors.
content.description: Nimbus offers a personalized, real-time on-chain portfolio view for Web3 investors, with tracking of investment profit and loss and impermanent loss for liquidity positions. It alerts you when a position is at risk and provides universal search to find terms, tokens, addresses, and transactions across every page you visit. You can click any address or transaction to see all relevant details in an easy format, with AI-assisted explanations to help newcomers understand crypto activity.
